'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 South Khorasan train derailment]]
**Twenty-two people are killed and 87 others injured after a train travelling between [[Mashhad]] and [[Yazd]] [[train wreck|collides]] with an [[excavator]] near [[Tabas]], [[South Khorasan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-middle-east-tehran-business-1291f7ad559e85eb630c1d3c8c3fe370 (AP)]
*[[2022 V-22 Osprey plane crash]]
**A [[United States Marine Corps]] [[Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey|V-22 Osprey]] crashes near the town of [[Glamis, California|Glamis]] in [[Imperial County, California]], United States, killing five U.S Marines onboard. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/military-plane-crash-osprey-california-desert/ (CBS News)]
*Ten people are killed and three are missing after heavy flooding in [[Hunan]] and [[Guangxi]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-china-climate-and-environment-80540c79a2f4b499102b02a067cec2eb (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Timeline of the 2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
****[[Texas]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://dentonrc.com/news/state/texas-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox-but-officials-say-it-poses-little-risk-to-the/article_75d55d90-cc7e-5ce6-b7d5-2762737005cb.html (''Denton Record-Chronicle'')]
****[[Arizona]] reports its first suspected case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.maricopa.gov/CivicAlerts.aspx?AID=2512 (Maricopa GOV)]
***[[Brazil]], [[Greece]] and [[Ghana]] report their first cases of monkeypox. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/sport/brazil-records-first-case-monkeypox-report-2735666 (CNA)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-detects-first-case-monkeypox-infection-2022-06-08/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cl5dygq2z3qo (BBC News)]
***[[Uganda]] and [[Cyprus]] report their first suspected cases of monkeypox. [https://www.dispatch.ug/2022/06/08/uganda-sends-four-suspected-monkeypox-samples-to-south-africa/ (Dispatch Uganda)] [https://www.financialmirror.com/2022/06/08/cyprus-monkeypox-alert-after-suspect-case/ (''Financial Mirror'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Florida]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#Sublineages and BA.2 subvariant|Omicron BA.4 variant]] at the Premier Medical Laboratory Services in three patients in [[Miami-Dade County, Florida|Miami-Dade County]]. [https://patch.com/florida/miami/first-ba-4-covid-19-subvariant-cases-found-fl-lab (Patch.com)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
***[[Ministry of Public Health (Thailand)|Public Health Minister]] [[Anutin Charnvirakul]] urges people to "move on" from [[COVID-19]] and declares his intentions for [[Thailand]] to [[Endemic phase of COVID-19|downgrade]] the disease to an [[Endemic (epidemiology)|endemic]]. However, he didn't include a time frame on when to do so and says that the situation will be reviewed by mid-June after bars, pubs and entertainment venues reopened in the country. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2322570/anutin-time-to-move-on-declare-covid-19-endemic (''Bangkok Post'')]
*[[Phase-out of fossil fuel vehicles]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes to phase out the sale of new combustion engine vehicles by 2035. [https://apnews.com/article/climate-european-parliament-union-and-environment-336524fead81e58eb755ba004880f201 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belgium–Democratic Republic of the Congo relations]]
**[[Monarchy of Belgium|King]] [[Philippe of Belgium]], in a speech to the [[Palais du Peuple (Kinshasa)|Congolese parliament]] in [[Kinshasa]], formally condemns [[Atrocities in the Congo Free State|the atrocities]] that occurred when the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] was [[Congo Free State|declared the personal property]] of his ancestor, [[Leopold II of Belgium]], saying that the colonial government "was one of unequal relations, unjustifiable in itself, marked by paternalism, discrimination and racism". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-61730651 (BBC News)]
*[[Algeria–Spain relations]]
**[[Algeria]] suspends a 20-year [[Treaty of friendship|friendship treaty]] with [[Spain]], and bans all imports from Spain, amid a disagreement over the [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]]'s position on the disputed [[Western Sahara]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/algeria-suspends-treaty-friendship-cooperation-with-spain-state-media-2022-06-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Berlin car attack]]
**One person is killed and 30 others, including 14 students, are injured, after a car drives into a crowd in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. A 29-year-old [[Armenians in Germany|German-Armenian]] man is arrested at the scene. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-61729102 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/vehicle-drives-into-crowd-berlin-least-10-injured-gemanys-rbb24-2022-06-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Brett Kavanaugh alleged assassination plot]]
**A 26-year-old man from [[Simi Valley, California]], is charged by the [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]] for attempting to murder a U.S. judge after being found at the house of [[Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States|Justice]] [[Brett Kavanaugh]] while armed with several weapons. According to authorities, the suspect planned to assassinate Kavanaugh and then commit suicide. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/08/politics/man-arrested-near-brett-kavanaugh-home/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Nigerian presidential election]]
**Former [[Governor of Lagos State]] [[Bola Tinubu]] wins the [[2023 Nigerian presidential election#All Progressives Congress|presidential primary]] of the ruling [[All Progressives Congress]] and officially becomes the party's nominee for the February 2023 general election. Tinubu, who served as Governor from 1999 to 2007, defeated [[Rotimi Amaechi]], [[Yemi Osinbajo]], and eleven other candidates to win the primary. [https://www.channelstv.com/2022/06/08/tinubu-beats-osinbajo-amaechi-11-others-to-win-apc-presidential-primary/ (Channels TV)]
*The [[United Kingdom]] decides against direct rule of the [[British Virgin Islands]] despite finding "gross failures of governance" in the [[British Overseas Territories|overseas territory]]. The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] will give the territory's new administration two years to reform before imposing direct rule, according to [[Foreign Secretary (United Kingdom)|Foreign Secretary]] [[Liz Truss]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-61736373 (BBC News)]
*[[Vitaliy Khotsenko]] is sworn as new Prime Minister of the [[Donetsk People's Republic]] following dimission of [[Alexander Ananchenko]]. [https://tass.com/world/1462497 (TASS)]
